title: Elite Dangerous Odyssey
notes: Worked absolutely flawless throughout the entire game from launcher to the actual game. Switching to D3DMetal improves performance and loading times substantially. Performance was a lot better than expected. 60+ FPS in Space, 40-50 in a space station. Ultra Settings at 1080p.

title: Elite Dangerous: Odyssey
notes: Performance is honestly kinda iffy. I have a macbook 16 m2 pro with 16 gigs of RAM but I'm getting medicore performance at best while on medium settings. 40 FPS when disembarking from the ship. 20 - 30 in the common room. Getting a good 50+- FPS when in space. This is at 1080p by the way. It took me a long while to fix the display settings since it was grainy and I couldn't up the resolution at all but switching to retina pixels should fix it with full screen mode through the in-game settings.
issues: Game went down to 10 fps when I was going through potential ships to buy in the shipyard. Possible Memory issue here. Only fixed after closing the game and highball and then opening it up again.
